wrc_development.description: Engine developed with WRC rally homologation in mind

notes.heritage: The G16E-GTS was developed by GAZOO Racing specifically for the GR Yaris WRC homologation special. It represents Toyota's return to high-performance turbocharged engines and the spiritual successor to engines like the 4A-GE and 3S-GTE. Akio Toyoda (Morizo) personally championed this project.
notes.reputation: The most powerful production 3-cylinder engine ever made. Toyota proved that a 3-cylinder can deliver thrilling performance while maintaining the brand's reliability reputation. Early reviews praise its linear power delivery and eager character.
notes.engineering_philosophy: Rather than fitting an existing engine, Toyota designed the G16E-GTS from scratch for performance. Every aspect was optimized for power density and response.
common_issues: New engine - limited long-term data available
Documented oil consumption in some early units
Turbo heat soak during aggressive driving
strengths: AWD system designed to handle the power
maintenance_critical: Oil change every 5,000 miles (essential with turbo)
Break-in procedure important for new engines

aftermarket_potential.description: Early aftermarket development shows strong potential
aftermarket_potential.estimated_potential: 350-400HP on stock turbo with supporting mods, 450+ with turbo upgrade
aftermarket_potential.considerations: New platform - long-term reliability data for modified engines still developing

wrc_connection.description: Direct connection to Toyota GAZOO Racing WRC program
wrc_connection.homologation_purpose: GR Yaris exists to homologate components for WRC
wrc_connection.rally_dna: Suspension, AWD system, and engine all derived from rally program
